name: Enel X
description: Enel's energy-services arm: demand response, virtual power plant and flexible-demand programmes, including data centres as a customer class. The business has been reorganised rather than sold - Italian solutions now sit on enel.it, the North American EV charging business ceased in October 2024, and North American demand response is presented under Enel North America.
products: Virtual power plant and flexibility services
notes: Recorded as Enel X (Enel X Italia S.r.l.), Rome, within the Enel Group. No loaded page states a sale of the demand-response business itself.
